result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but there are several visual defects: a nonsensical '-0%' discount badge, hard-clipped restaurant name text in the horizontal carousel, inconsistent favorite-button styling between cards, and a washed-out/low-contrast first card image. Cut-off carousel items are acceptable scroll affordances, but the truncation lacks ellipsis.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card shows a promotional badge reading '-0%', which communicates no discount at all and looks like a data/formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 (or null), and only render it for values greater than 0.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third item's title is hard-clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') at the screen edge with no ellipsis, so it reads as broken text rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis constrained to the card width, and ensure the card itself is clipped at a consistent peek offset rather than cutting the label arbitrarily.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (one background and icon color, or a consistent scrim) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) is very light/washed out compared to the dark, contrasty neighbours, and its white '15–25 min' pill has weak contrast against the pale background.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (add a subtle gradient scrim or consistent background) and give time pills a solid background/border so they remain legible on light imagery.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is sliced by the fixed bottom navigation bar with no visible fade or padding, making the content appear cut off rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully clear of the tab bar.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' uses light grey text that may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast against the white background.
